steps.stdout:
Tie the current agent session to a task.

Tasks have no custom fields, so the association is written as a marker in a
task comment. The session is identified by KANEO_SESSION_ID, falling back to
CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID.

Usage:
  kaneo session [command]

Available Commands:
  attach      Record that this session is working on a task
  close       Mark this session's task as no longer held
  next        Record what this session will do next

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for session

Global Flags:
      --api-key string     API key; prefer KANEO_API_KEY, since a flag is visible in the process list
      --api-url string     Kaneo base URL (env KANEO_API_URL)
      --human              force human-readable output, even through a pipe
      --json               force JSON output
  -p, --project string     project id (env KANEO_PROJECT)
      --timeout duration   per-request timeout (default 10s)
  -w, --workspace string   workspace id (env KANEO_WORKSPACE)

Use "kaneo session [command] --help" for more information about a command.
